page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 32 shared vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.0 GB of RAM per core. The server integrates three NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a total of 72 GB of VRAM.

This configuration does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached for persistent data. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce resource contention compared to dedicated CPU instances, though the high memory capacity and triple GPU setup offset this for specific workloads.

From a qualitative cost perspective, the server offers high resource density by combining a substantial memory footprint with multiple enterprise-grade GPUs on a shared CPU model. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science jobs, and GPU-accelerated rendering where GPU and memory capacity are prioritized over dedicated single-core CPU performance.
